CA_choice: A git ref no checkout holds (independent agreement)
CB_choice: A git ref no checkout holds (independent agreement)

cost_CB: Same; adds a history.md export whose writer and time are not stated

CA_choice: One ref per repository, one file per Mission
CB_choice: One ref per Mission plus one for Ops

cost_CB: One extra branch per Mission on the forge; CI triggers on push; cleanup after landing

CB_choice: One work branch per work package (independent agreement)

cost_CB: Same; probe not named

CA_choice: On approval, merge --no-ff into the Mission branch (independent agreement)
CB_choice: On approval; approval recorded only with integration (independent agreement)

cost_CB: Same; conflict path is refuse, take the Mission branch in, review again
decided_by: Product ruling by the architect; two-clone reproduction of the join first

CA_choice: Tree equality; fast-forward or squash (independent agreement)
CB_choice: Tree equality; merge with accepted second parent, or squash (independent agreement)
cost_CA: Squash makes git branch -d refuse every merged branch; no proof about canceled lines; no attestations
cost_CB: Same loss of attestations; override event is the one exception path
decided_by: Ruling on default strategy; one absorption check if squash stays

CA_choice: Six states, blocked as a flag, override as its own event (independent agreement)
CB_choice: Same (independent agreement)
cost_CA: claimed and done vanish as names; clients and prompts update once
cost_CB: Same; 12 pack prompts
decided_by: State reduction before the ledger contract reaches 1.0

CA_choice: spec_kitty_events Python library, in process
CB_choice: Events system as one Java service behind the existing port

cost_CB: Resident native process on every write; launcher, pins, release line; no pure-Python install
decided_by: Ruling on whether a resident native process is required for 4.0; same ref format keeps it reversible

CA_choice: Events system, inside append (independent agreement)
CB_choice: Events system; git facts supplied by core (independent agreement)

cost_CB: Same across a pinned binary; reviewer-independence guard not found in the Java service
decided_by: Ruling that the state machine is an events-domain rule; a rule-by-rule comparison of the Java guards with core

cost_CB: A clone may need the charter system installed to compile; one switch with no shadow period
decided_by: Ruling on whether a clone must work without the charter system; a date for the Python compiler

CA_choice: Ordered pack list plus exclusions (independent agreement)
CB_choice: Same, plus the organisation floor (independent agreement)
